WITH combination_counts AS (
  SELECT
    ab.translink,
    tr.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tr
    ON tr.transreg = ab.translink
  WHERE ab.peercorr > 0.149
    AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist
),
scored AS (
  SELECT
    translink,
    ordertypedist,
    record_count,
    CAST(record_count AS REAL) / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ordertypedist) AS fraction
  FROM combination_counts
)
SELECT translink, ordertypedist, record_count, fraction
FROM scored
ORDER BY fraction DESC
LIMIT 10;
